item.command:
/bin/bash -lc './mvnw -B -s settings.xml -pl filter/app -am test > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 &
build_pid=$!
printf '"'Build PID: %s\\n' \""'$build_pid"
wait "$build_pid"
build_status=$?
printf '"'Build exit code: %s\\n' \""'$build_status"
tail -n 15 /tmp/build.log
exit "$build_status"'
